Professional Objective 
Results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 5+ years of experience in designing, developing, 
and implementing enterprise solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CSM, CMDB and 
GRC/IRM modules. Skilled in workflow automation, platform customization, REST API 
integrations, and enterprise application development, with a strong focus on delivering scalable, 
secure, and efficient solutions. Committed to enhancing service delivery, optimizing business 
processes, improving user experience, and driving operational excellence while contributing to 
organizational growth and digital transformation initiatives. 
 
Professional Summary 
 Dynamic and results-driven ServiceNow Developer with 4+ years of experience in 
designing, developing, and implementing scalable, secure, and enterprise-grade 
ServiceNow solutions across ITSM, ITOM, HRSD, CMDB, and GRC/IRM modules. 
 Extensive experience implementing and enhancing core ITSM processes, including 
Incident, Problem, Change, Request, Knowledge Management, Service Catalog, and 
Service Portal, while developing complex Catalog Items, Record Producers, reusable 
workflows, and automated fulfillment processes. 
 Strong expertise in ServiceNow platform development using Business Rules, Client 
Scripts, Script Includes, UI Policies, UI Actions, ACLs, Data Policies, Scheduled 
Jobs, Background Scripts, Glide API, and server-side scripting, following 
ServiceNow best practices to deliver upgrade-safe and maintainable solutions. 
 Hands-on experience implementing and customizing HR Service Delivery (HRSD) 
solutions, including HR Case Management, Employee Service Center, HR 
Knowledge Base, Lifecycle Events, Employee Document Management, and 
Employee Service Requests, improving employee experience through streamlined HR 
processes. 
 Experienced in configuring and enhancing GRC/IRM solutions, including Policy and 
Compliance Management, Risk Management, Control Management, Issue 
Management, Risk Assessments, Vendor Risk Management, and Audit 
Management, helping organizations strengthen governance, regulatory compliance, and 
enterprise risk visibility. 
 Proficient in designing risk assessment questionnaires, risk scoring models, control 
testing workflows, compliance indicators, issue remediation plans, and automated 
approval workflows to support enterprise governance and risk management initiatives. 
 Good understanding of CMDB, Discovery, CI class modeling, relationship mapping, and 
dependency management to improve service visibility and operational stability across 
enterprise environments. 
 Hands-on experience integrating ServiceNow with external applications using REST 
APIs, IntegrationHub, and third-party services, implementing payload transformations, 
OAuth 2.0/Bearer token authentication, and event-driven integrations. 
 Experienced in developing automation using Flow Designer, Workflows, Flow Logic, 
Subflows, Business Rules, Events, and Scheduled Jobs to reduce manual effort and 
improve operational efficiency. 
 Skilled in application migration and release management using Update Sets, Scoped 
Applications, Application Repository, and version-controlled deployment practices 
across development, testing, and production environments. 
 Strong experience implementing platform security using Access Control Lists (ACLs), 
role-based access control (RBAC), data validation, and governance best practices to 
ensure secure and compliant application development. 
 Proficient in creating Performance Analytics dashboards, reports, workspace 
components, notifications, and executive-level reporting, enabling data-driven 
decision-making and operational visibility. 
 Excellent analytical, troubleshooting, and problem-solving skills with proven ability to 
gather requirements, collaborate with cross-functional teams, and deliver high-quality 
ServiceNow solutions aligned with ITIL best practices and modern ServiceNow 
architecture.

 Enhanced user experience by customizing Service Portal, developing reusable widgets,

 Performed root cause analysis, debugging, log analysis, and performance tuning to

 Collaborated with business stakeholders, compliance teams, risk managers, and cross-
functional development teams to gather requirements, design scalable solutions, and 
deliver enterprise applications aligned with ITIL and organizational governance 
standards.
